about: The postcommunio of the formulary “4th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the sacrament we have received cleanse us, we beseech You, O Lord, and by its grace protect us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
